content:
Typical High-End GPU Area Budget Allocation:
- SM array (compute cores): 35-45% of die area
  - Each SM: ~4-6 mm2 on TSMC 4nm (varies by generation)
- L2 Cache: 15-25% of die area
  - SRAM density: ~0.2-0.3 Mbit/mm2 at advanced nodes
- Memory controllers + PHY: 10-15% of die area
  - Each 32-bit memory controller slice: ~2-3 mm2
- NoC/Interconnect fabric: 8-12% of die area
- NVLink/PCIe PHYs: 8-12% of die area
- Clock/Power/Test/Other: 5-10% of die area

Reticle limit: 858 mm2 (33mm x 26mm maximum single die)
Chiplet strategy required beyond ~800 mm2 for yield reasons
Typical GPU die sizes:
- Hopper H100: 814 mm2 (near reticle limit)
- Ampere A100: 826 mm2
- Blackwell GB100: ~600 mm2 per die x 2 dies (chiplet)
